newsitem.title: USA: Dow soars to record close, S&P passes 700 level.
newsitem.headline: Dow soars to record close, S&P passes 700 level.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks soared to another record close Friday and the S&P 500 jumped past 700 points for the first time after a surprisingly weak September payrolls report calmed inflation fears and sparked a bond market rally.
The Dow Jones industrial average surged 60.01 points to end at 5,992.86, according to early, unofficial results. The Standard & Poor's index of 500 stocks gained 8.68 to 701.46.
In the broader market, advancers swamped declines by a nearly 3-to-1 margin on heavy volume of 467 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
